name: navigation-menu
description: A source-owned Dioxus navigation menu backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied facade styles adico-primitives::navigation_menu directly; roving-focus top-level items, hover-intent opening (with immediate switching between already-open siblings), and Positioner-anchored content all remain inside adico-primitives. NavigationMenuContent caps its height to the positioner's available space and scrolls internally rather than clipping overflowing content.
documentation.accessibility: NavigationMenuTrigger is aria-expanded/aria-controls-wired to its NavigationMenuContent; NavigationMenuContent renders role="region" via Positioner (packages/adico-primitives/src/navigation_menu.rs).
documentation.keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move the roving highlight across top-level items; Home/End jump to the first/last. Note: no cross-sibling coordination between two different open top-level submenus yet -- a named, documented primitive limitation, not this facade's own gap.
